name: Floral nectar, as foraged
source: Dilute sugar solution collected by foraging bees: illustrative proximate (per kg) water 800 g, sugars 195 g (~20%, a representative mid-range floral nectar concentration; real nectar ranges roughly 5-70% sugar by species), ash 5 g.
notes: Sugar is modelled with the sucrose elemental ratio (nectar sugar is a mixture of sucrose, glucose and fructose, all very close in C:H:O ratio; sucrose is used as the single representative, the same simplification sugar-beet.json makes for beet root). Honey.json's moisture reduction (origin/honey.ts) draws from this file via the same real water-removal technique agri/harvest.ts's dryGrain uses.
